text_block_list.text: One day, while walking around campus――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~... I need to calm my mind and think. 
A training method that bears both flower 
and fruit would be...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Eep!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...T-That was a close call. We were almost 
about to crash――
choice_data_list: Look where you're going when you walk.
Make sure to watch where you're walking.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry! Are you hurt at all? My head 
was just totally somewhere else!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness... What a relief! I really 
shouldn't be walking while looking away 
like that.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Y-Yes, training... I've been fretting 
over what kind of routine would suit me 
best...
choice_data_list:
How about focusing thoroughly on just one 
type?
How about trying a few different things?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, good point! Even if you water it, 
sprouts don't just pop up right away...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
In other words, 'A great bloom does not 
blossom in a day.'

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
What a wonderful maxim! I need to jot this 
down in my Chiyo Notebook later.
choice_data_list:
(I feel like there was a proverb like 
that...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
All right, without wavering, I'm gonna 
pick one thing and master it all the way 
through!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
. Thanks to that, I feel like I can truly 
throw myself into training!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I will never forget your kindness! Next 
time we meet, I will surely repay you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Well, whenever you have some free 
time. Excuse me!

Sakura Chiyono O ran off toward the 
training gym.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see. Just as you say, we might not 
know if it fits unless we actually try it 
out...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
In other words, 'Sow enough seeds of 
bounty, and some are bound to sprout!'

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to jot down this maxim in my 
"Chiyo-Notebook" later.
choice_data_list:
(Less of a wise maxim and more of just 
stating the obvious, isn't it?)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm gonna try every single kind 
of training you can do at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, the fog has cleared! It 
feels as though my heart has become 
completely serene.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I will never forget your kindness! Next 
time we meet, I will surely repay you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: No, not at all. You were a huge help!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Please don't hesitate to let me know 
whenever something comes up. I'd love 
nothing more than to lend a hand!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, see you later then. Excuse me.

Sakura Chiyono O walked away with a 
friendly, welcoming smile.
